critical_code_review_comments: analytics.py recovery_funnel does 4 sequential aggregations for the weekly series — fine at current volume but could be a single $bucket/$facet aggregation once event volume grows.

ContributorWall useEffect for highlight returns cleanup from inside requestAnimationFrame — the returned cleanup is thrown away by React (rAF callback return is ignored). If the component unmounts within the 2.5s window the setTimeout will still fire on unmounted state. Non-critical (setPulseNick on unmounted just warns in dev), but the intent-cleanup is dead code.
